items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
4 - 7 years of related experience.
Previous supervisory/managerial experience.
Interprets regulations and guidelines and prepares periodic reports. (20% time)

Supervises the work of a section of nonexempt financial services employees who are primarily involved in performing transactional and processing functions, with responsibility for quality and quantity of work. (10% time)
Develops work schedules and appropriate assignments in consultation with manager. Monitors the progress of work of the unit. (10% time)
Supervises and follows cash and payment handling policies and procedures. (10% time)
Ensures that the appropriate internal controls are addressed, maintained and strengthened to protect University resources. (10% time)
Participates in the development and monitoring of policies and procedures for financial data management. (10% time)
Participates in or provides input to decisions regarding hiring of new employees, transfers, promotions, salary actions, terminations, performance management and budget recommendations. (5% time)
Interacts with all levels in unit with peer level supervisors in other parts of the organization. (5% time)
Reviews, processes, and approves financial data and transactions. (5% time)
Researches, reconciles and resolves data discrepancies. (5% time)

Provides guidance to staff and monitors customer service levels for the unit to various constituencies. Makes ongoing recommendations and process changes to ensure effective and efficient customer service. (5% time)
Meets all government reporting and auditing requirements for related financial activities. (5% time)
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Constantly
Perform Calculations: Constantly
Communicate Orally: Constantly
Reason & Analyze: Constantly
Bend: Occasionally
Sit: Constantly
Stand: Occasionally
Walk: Occasionally
Thorough knowledge of financial transactions and financial systems.
Ability to perform routine financial analysis and reporting.
Proficiency in use of spreadsheet and database software.

Ability to thrive in a busy, high-volume, and deadline driven work environment that requires coordination of multiple activities and the judgment and flexibility to reprioritize to accommodate emergency requests. Detail oriented.

Interpersonal skills, service orientation, active listening, critical thinking, ability to multi-task effectively in a high volume environment, organizational skills and effective verbal and written communication skills.
Knowledge of human resources policies and procedures.
Ability to manage changing priorities, and manage staff time and efforts accordingly.
Intermediate knowledge and understanding of internal control practices and their impact on protecting University resources.
